name: zetesis
description: Zetesis: full scientific due diligence, grounded in dated and retrieved evidence.

plugins.name: zetesis
plugins.description: Full scientific due diligence inside your assistant. Routes a claim to its class, then returns the questions a domain reviewer would ask (substrate, methods, cohort, risk-of-bias), the failure patterns that have caught comparable claims before with their named precedents, and dated evidence from Europe PMC, ClinicalTrials.gov, openFDA, NIH RePORTER and SEC EDGAR with a hard identifier on every source. Retrieval can be fenced to a year so a claim is judged on what was knowable then.
